text:
alice: Heads up — corporate card declined when customer tried to pay invoice INV-4521 via the billing UI. Customer says bank returned 'merchant category restricted' and won't allow the charge. Invoice is $8,500. They need this settled today, is there a quick workaround? Screenshot: https://files.redwood/example-screenshot.png

samir: Do we have the gateway error details? Might be a per-transaction limit vs. category block. Ask them for last4 and the exact bank message. I'll triage once we have the gateway id.

alice: Pasting gateway response from our side:```{"status":402, "decline_code":"mcc_rejected_by_payer", "message":"Declined - blocked merchant type by payer policy", "gateway_tx":"tx_673829"}```

billing-bot: Payment attempt logged: invoice=INV-4521, amount=8500 USD, status=declined, reason=mcc_restricted, gateway_tx=tx_673829

maria: If this is an MCC restriction on their corporate card, options: (1) use an alternate card (personal or another corporate card) (2) pay by wire/ACH (we can provide wire details) or (3) procurement can whitelist this vendor/category with the bank. We can also accept a PO and process manually if they need net terms. Which does the customer prefer? :thinking:

alice: Customer says procurement requires a PO for anything >5k and their card policies block certain merchant categories. They offered to raise a PO (PO 2026-00321) or do a wire. They prefer PO + net30.

dev-support: From our end this is not a product bug. Repro steps I ran: 1) Billing UI -> Invoices -> INV-4521 -> Click Pay -> Enter card -> Confirm -> Payment gateway returns 402 + decline_code mcc_rejected_by_payer. Gateway log id: tx_673829. HTTP response snippet:```HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":{"code":402,"decline_code":"mcc_rejected_by_payer","message":"Declined - blocked merchant type"}}```

samir: Thanks. I'll open a payment ops ticket and loop finance for PO acceptance. Please collect: customer name, billing contact email, company tax id (for invoice), PO number, and last4 of the card (for audit). I'll create internal ticket PAY-5937 and tag payments-ops.

alice: Added details to PAY-5937: customer "Helix Data Labs", billing contact lisa@helixdl.com, company tax id 12-3456789, PO 2026-00321, card last4 4321. Customer will either send the signed PO today or do a wire tomorrow morning.

maria: I can process manual settlement once we receive the PO + signed form or wire proof. If they want the original card to work, procurement needs to ask their bank to whitelist our merchant category (they should reference the gateway description shown in the screenshot). For now I'll prepare a pro forma invoice and the wire instructions and send to lisa@helixdl.com.

alice: I'll follow up with the customer and confirm which route they pick. Thanks everyone. :pray:

billing-bot: Invoice INV-4521 status updated: awaiting-customer-action (PO pending). Logged to PAY-5937.
